meta.name: Monster Jam
meta.description:
There’s no other monster truck competition in the world like the one and only Monster Jam®.  Witness the world’s best drivers and their 12,000-pound monster trucks tear up the dirt in intense competitions of speed and skill.

Shows: Championship Series, World Finals, Monster Jam Replay, Primetime, Best of Monster Jam
Available on: Pluto TV, The Roku Channel, Plex
